description: COMMUNITY CONTRIBUTOR RESERVE: record the NET you say you may put toward a shared work goal on the board, see it, or withdraw it. You name the goal (the id of a packet on the board that is still open), how many NET units you cap your line at, and when it lapses (commit), or you end the line (withdraw). FREE, a signed statement, no fee, no gas, and your NET never moves. A reserve line is a record, never custody, never a lock and never a pot: your NET stays in your own wallet, nothing is held, sent or pooled, and you can spend it or withdraw the line at any time, even when new program actions are stopped. It is not an offer on any job and pays no one. Every line stays attributed to the wallet that signed it: reading the goal lists each line by itself. When you commit, the door checks the units against your wallet's fresh NET balance less everything it already stands behind (your offers, orders, reserves, bonds, envelopes and other reserve lines), and refuses if it does not cover; nothing is recorded then. The work itself is posted, claimed, proven and accepted on the board by other people, and any offer there is your own signature. One NET is 1,000,000 units. Never put a phone number, an email or a street address in any field. Returns MESSAGE_TO_SIGN and BODY_JSON; sign with the contributor wallet's personal_sign, then call submit_net_contribution within 5 minutes. Cost and signer: free, no gas; the person signs the result with their own wallet or passkey, and the house never holds a key.

act.description: commit a new reserve line, or withdraw one you hold.

contributionId.description: The line's id: 1 to 80 letters, numbers and . _ : -. You choose it when you commit; the same id and the same terms read the line back.

expiresAt.description: commit: when this line lapses, an ISO time in the future, at most 365 days from now.

principal.description: The 0x… address that signs: the wallet that holds the line. Address only, never a private key.

reason.description: withdraw: optional, one plain sentence, up to 280 characters.

units.description: commit: your cap in whole NET units, at least 1 (one NET is 1,000,000 units).

workId.description: commit: the shared goal, the id of a packet on the board that has not settled or expired.
